title: Zen Bound
notes: Physical ARM64 smoke test on 2026-10-09, IPA SHA-256 631BFD730339DD8F9AB37FF3A404CC49A30C85CC5DA418267D102D98B72A3D0E. Full-level progression, audio, saves and sustained performance were not tested.
